blurb: A message bundle is a set of locale blocks, and the compiler checks every locale against one of them, the reference, marked `@reference`. It is also the fallback when a requested locale is not declared. With no reference there is nothing to check the others against, so exactly one block per commons must carry the mark. Add `@reference` to the locale your strings are written in first. Two marked blocks are `bynk.messages.multiple_reference`.
summary: A message bundle has no `@reference` block.
